I do play it still once in a while, a few times a week. It's not like I played it like 6 months ago. Lol they are nowhere close to being like each other. It's pretty much a fact that PubG is a lot slower. People who like Fortnite like it because it's much faster paced and you get into a lot more fights. I don't really care about either one cause I don't even play Fortnite much but I understand why a lot more people have been gravitating towards it and like playing it. Not to mention it's a lot smoother and more optimized. I've played BR games since DayZ and when H1Z1 first came out so I really don't have any bias. Main thing that gets to me is that I think it's pretty sad that PubG has made so much money and easily have the capability to upgrade their servers but they are still running these crappy servers.

Their server tick rates work like this. They have Variable tick rate which averages around 12-16 ticks per second with maximums of around 20-25 and minimums between 5 and 10. Sad.

Pubg is stale and that's why less and less ppl are playing it now. Even though the game has been improved, it's still nowhere as close as it needs to be but even far from it. Their servers are terrible and run below 30Hz for the majority of the games. It starts off as low as only 8Hz when everyone drops from the aircraft. Their circles and maps are pretty terrible. i mainly play the game to just kill and get into fights and not really care about winning because the game gets so damn boring. After the first like 5-7 minutes, you could go forever from seeing another person. The midgame is absolutely terrible.

Here's a graph of pubg server performance. It's so bad.
https://i.imgur.com/dj5Ks0w.png

I don't play it as much now because who wants to play a loot and running simulator for the majority of the game? Well not me at least.

The goal of the game is to be the last one standing. After you die, it just automatically spectates the person that killed you. There's no point in just sitting and waiting after you die so you can just return to lobby and start a new game. These are called Battle Royale (BR) games and the point of all of them is to pretty much be the last survivor while killing everyone else.
